title: How a Man of God Studies for Finals Without Living on Panic
caption:
Finals week has a way of showing what a man actually trusts.

Some guys pray and never study. Some guys study like it all depends on them and haven't prayed since September. Neither one is faith.

Pray for thirty seconds before you open the laptop. Hit the hardest subject first. Go to bed. Sit next to the one guy who actually studies. Then walk out of that exam and leave the grade with God.

"It is in vain that you rise up early and go late to rest... for he gives to his beloved sleep." Psalm 127:2

Save this for the week it gets heavy. Send it to the brother running on three hours of sleep.
